text:
Q1: What are the standard office hours?
A: Standard office hours are 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday through Friday.
Q2: How many annual leave days do employees receive?
A: Employees receive 24 annual leave days per calendar year.
Q3: Are employees allowed to work remotely?
A: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval.
Q4: What is the probation period for new employees?
A: The probation period is six months from the joining date.
Q5: How often are performance reviews conducted?
A: Performance reviews are conducted twice a year.
Q6: When are salaries paid?
A: Salaries are paid on the last working day of each month.
Q7: How can employees apply for leave?
A: Leave requests must be submitted through the HR portal.
Q8: What is the notice period for resignation?
A: The standard notice period is 60 days.
Q9: Are employees eligible for maternity leave?
A: Eligible employees receive 26 weeks of maternity leave.
Q10: Are employees eligible for paternity leave?
A: Eli

gible employees receive 10 working days of paternity leave.
Q11: What is the dress code policy?
A: Employees are expected to wear business casual attire.
Q12: How are public holidays determined?
A: Public holidays follow the annual company holiday calendar.
Q13: Can employees carry forward unused leave?
A: Up to 10 unused leave days may be carried forward.
Q14: Is overtime compensated?
A: Overtime compensation depends on employee grade and local regulations.
Q15: Who handles employee grievances?
A: Employee grievances are managed by the HR department.
IT Support

-- 1 of 7 --

Q16: How do employees reset their password?
A: Passwords can be reset using the self-service password portal.
Q17: What is the IT help desk email address?
A: The IT help desk email is support@company.example.
Q18: What are the help desk operating hours?
A: The help desk operates 24/7.
Q19: How can software installation requests be submitted?
A: Requests must be submitted through the IT ticketing system.
Q20: What

operating systems are officially supported?
A: Windows 11 and macOS are officially supported.
Q21: How often should passwords be changed?
A: Passwords should be changed every 90 days.
Q22: Is VPN access required for remote work?
A: Yes, VPN access is mandatory for remote connections.
Q23: What is the maximum email attachment size?
A: The maximum attachment size is 25 MB.
Q24: How should employees report phishing emails?
A: Employees should use the "Report Phishing" button in the email client.
Q25: Are personal devices allowed for work?
A: Personal devices are allowed only if enrolled in device management.
Security Policies
Q26: What should employees do if they suspect a security breach?
A: Immediately notify the Security Operations Team.
Q27: Are USB drives allowed?
A: Only company-approved encrypted USB drives are permitted.
Q28: How long are security logs retained?
A: Security logs are retained for one year.
Q29: What is multi-factor authentication?
A: MFA requires two or more metho

ds of identity verification.
Q30: Is MFA mandatory?
A: Yes, MFA is mandatory for all employee accounts.

-- 2 of 7 --

Q31: How often is security awareness training required?
A: Employees must complete training annually.
Q32: What is the clean desk policy?
A: Sensitive information must not be left unattended.
Q33: Can confidential data be shared externally?
A: Only with authorized approval and proper safeguards.
Q34: What is classified as confidential information?
A: Customer, employee, financial, and proprietary business data.
Q35: What should employees do if a laptop is lost?
A: Report the loss immediately to IT and Security.
Finance
Q36: How are travel expenses reimbursed?
A: Through the expense management portal.
Q37: What is the reimbursement submission deadline?
A: Within 30 days of the expense date.
Q38: Are receipts required for reimbursement?
A: Yes, receipts are required for all claims.
Q39: What currency is used for financial reporting?
A: US Dollars (USD).
Q40: Who approves

travel expenses?
A: The employee's direct manager.
Q41: What is the petty cash limit?
A: The petty cash limit is $100.
Q42: How often are financial audits conducted?
A: Financial audits are conducted annually.
Q43: What is the procurement approval threshold?
A: Purchases above $5,000 require additional approval.
Q44: Can employees use personal credit cards for business expenses?
A: Yes, if company cards are unavailable.
Q45: How long are financial records retained?
A: Financial records are retained for seven years.

-- 3 of 7 --

Products
Q46: What is Product Alpha?
A: Product Alpha is the company's analytics platform.
Q47: What is Product Beta?
A: Product Beta is a customer relationship management solution.
Q48: Which product supports predictive analytics?
A: Product Alpha supports predictive analytics.
Q49: Which product integrates with third-party CRM systems?
A: Product Beta supports CRM integrations.
Q50: Does Product Alpha support cloud deployment?
A: Yes, Product Alpha supports

cloud deployment.
Q51: Does Product Beta offer mobile access?
A: Yes, Product Beta includes mobile applications.
Q52: Which product includes dashboard reporting?
A: Product Alpha includes dashboard reporting.
Q53: What database does Product Alpha use?
A: Product Alpha uses PostgreSQL.
Q54: What API protocol does Product Beta support?
A: Product Beta supports REST APIs.
Q55: Are both products available globally?
A: Yes, both products are available globally.
Customer Support
Q56: What is the customer support email?
A: support@company.example
Q57: What are support hours?
A: Customer support is available 24/7.
Q58: What is the response time for critical issues?
A: Critical issues receive a response within one hour.
Q59: How are support tickets prioritized?
A: Based on severity and business impact.

-- 4 of 7 --

Q60: What is the escalation process?
A: Tickets are escalated to senior engineers when necessary.
Operations
Q61: What is the company's headquarters location?
A: The headquarters

is located in New York.
Q62: How many regional offices exist?
A: There are five regional offices.
Q63: What is the business continuity objective?
A: Maintain critical services during disruptions.
Q64: How often are disaster recovery tests conducted?
A: Twice per year.
Q65: What is the recovery time objective (RTO)?
A: Four hours.
Q66: What is the recovery point objective (RPO)?
A: Fifteen minutes.
Q67: Who manages vendor relationships?
A: The Procurement Team.
Q68: How often are vendor reviews conducted?
A: Annually.
Q69: What project methodology is commonly used?
A: Agile methodology.
Q70: How are operational incidents tracked?
A: Through the incident management system.
Data Management
Q71: What is the primary customer database?
A: CustomerDB.
Q72: How often are database backups taken?
A: Every six hours.
Q73: How long are backups retained?
A: Ninety days.

-- 5 of 7 --

Q74: Is data encrypted at rest?
A: Yes, all production data is encrypted at rest.
Q75: Is data encrypted in transit

?
A: Yes, TLS encryption is required.
Q76: Who can access production databases?
A: Authorized database administrators only.
Q77: What is the data retention policy for customer records?
A: Customer records are retained for seven years.
Q78: What format is used for data exports?
A: CSV and JSON formats.
Q79: How are backup restorations validated?
A: Through scheduled recovery tests.
Q80: What monitoring tool is used for databases?
A: DBMonitor Pro.
Compliance
Q81: What privacy regulation does the company follow?
A: GDPR and applicable local regulations.
Q82: How often is compliance training required?
A: Once per year.
Q83: What is a data subject access request?
A: A request to access personal data held by the company.
Q84: How quickly must access requests be handled?
A: Within 30 days.
Q85: Are compliance audits performed?
A: Yes, compliance audits are conducted annually.
Miscellaneous
Q86: What collaboration platform does the company use?
A: Microsoft Teams.
Q87: What video conferencing

tool is used?
A: Microsoft Teams Meetings.

Q88: What document management platform is used?
A: SharePoint.
Q89: What browser is recommended?
A: Google Chrome.
Q90: What coding repository platform is used?
A: GitHub Enterprise.
Q91: What CI/CD platform is used?
A: Jenkins.
Q92: What cloud provider is primarily used?
A: AWS.
Q93: What monitoring platform is used?
A: Datadog.
Q94: What ticketing platform is used?
A: ServiceNow.
Q95: What messaging platform is used for alerts?
A: Slack.
Q96: What is the maximum vacation carry-forward limit?
A: Ten days.
Q97: How often are company town halls held?
A: Quarterly.
Q98: What language is used for official communication?
A: English.
Q99: What is the company mission?
A: To deliver secure and innovative technology solutions.
Q100: What is the company vision?
A: To be a global leader in digital transformation.
